XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS AI Content Translation — Phase T.0 (MVP) schema. Two tables: translations_log (one row per translation request) + brand_overrides (per-customer per-language brand-name substitution map, e.g. 'Airpay' -> the Kannada-script form).

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_tr_log
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase T.0 (2026-05-25) — One row per translation request. Lifecycle: pending (created, API call in flight) -> translated (Claude returned, awaiting save) -> saved (admin accepted the diff) -> failed (API error) -> discarded (admin rejected the diff).
'sourcehash' is a SHA-1 of (sourcetext + targetlang) used as a dedup / translation-memory key in T.4.
'brand_terms_applied' records how many brand-override substitutions were applied to the output, for audit.
'customerid' + 'costcenterid' follow the standard Sentientia LMS multi-customer / multi-tenant scope convention.

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — admin who created the translation.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). Derived from creator open_path at translation time.

FIELD.NAME: sourcehash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of sourcetext + targetlang. Dedup / translation-memory key.

FIELD.NAME: sourcelang
FIELD.COMMENT: Source language code. Phase T.0: always 'en'.

FIELD.NAME: targetlang
FIELD.COMMENT: Target language code: hi | mr | kn | sw.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Admin-supplied label for the translation queue list.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetext
FIELD.COMMENT: The verbatim English source text sent to Claude.

FIELD.NAME: translatedtext
FIELD.COMMENT: The translated output (after brand-override post-processing). NULL until status=translated.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic model identifier used for the translation. Recorded for audit.

FIELD.NAME: prompt_version
FIELD.COMMENT: System-prompt revision tag. Allows safe A/B prompt-quality testing.

FIELD.NAME: brand_terms_applied
FIELD.COMMENT: Count of brand-override substitutions applied to the output.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_in
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic input_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_out
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic output_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: mock | live — which client generated this row.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | translated | saved | failed | discarded

FIELD.NAME: error_detail
FIELD.COMMENT: On status=failed: the exception message + HTTP code (no API key, never log keys).

FIELD.NAME: generated_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of translation completion (or attempt timestamp on failure).

INDEX.NAME: idx_owner_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Admin translation queue: 'my translations awaiting save'

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_tr_brand
TABLE.COMMENT: Phase T.0 (2026-05-25) — Per-customer, per-target-language brand-name substitution map. When translating into a target language, every occurrence of `brand_source` in the output is replaced with `brand_target` so a brand renders in the correct local script (e.g. 'Airpay' -> the Kannada-script form for kn). When no row exists for a (customer, brand, lang) triple, the brand is preserved verbatim (Latin script) by the prompt instruction. The unique key prevents duplicate mappings for the same brand in the same language for the same customer.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: brand_source
FIELD.COMMENT: The brand term as it appears in English source (e.g. 'Airpay').

FIELD.NAME: targetlang
FIELD.COMMENT: Target language code this override applies to: hi | mr | kn | sw.

FIELD.NAME: brand_target
FIELD.COMMENT: The brand term in the target script (e.g. the Kannada-script form of 'Airpay').

INDEX.NAME: uniq_customer_brand_lang
INDEX.COMMENT: One mapping per brand per language per customer

INDEX.NAME: idx_customer_lang
INDEX.COMMENT: Load the override map for a (customer, lang) pair
